process.name: cmd.exe
process.command_line: cmd.exe /c vssadmin delete shadows /all /quiet & wbadmin delete catalog -quiet & bcdedit /set recoveryenabled No

labels.why: Deleting every shadow copy is ransomware preparation and has essentially no administrative use on a workstation. Bishop has no dedicated detector, but the command line is obfuscated enough that encoded_command should carry it.
